description: Skeleton 002: prove that exactly one declared Wuxia-Life source modification can execute from an exact sealed source baseline and enter a new Phase 0 player-observable run as the only non-ignored source delta.

userStories.title: Run one isolated modification from an exact sealed baseline
userStories.description: As the Auto Evolution exploration owner, I want the Runtime to snapshot the actual current source into an isolated synthetic baseline, apply exactly one declared player-visible modification, and prove the resulting Phase 0 run used baseline plus only that modification.
acceptanceCriteria: Seal a deterministic manifest of the origin repository's actual tracked plus non-ignored untracked source bytes at experiment start, including origin headSha, branch, dirty status identity, sorted file entries, and SHA-256 values
Copy the sealed baseline into .tmp/evolution/skeleton-002/workspace and prove the pre-modification isolated source entries exactly match the origin baseline manifest
Initialize a synthetic Git repository only inside the isolated workspace, commit the copied baseline, and verify its non-ignored worktree is clean before modification

Modify only isolated workspace src/data/lines/general.json event birth_wuxia_family content.text by appending exact marker AE-SKELETON-002; origin src/data/lines/general.json must never contain the marker
After modification, after deterministic tests, and after the Phase 0 run, synthetic Git status has exactly one non-ignored dirty entry: ' M src/data/lines/general.json'
npm run typecheck passes in the isolated workspace
npx tsx tests/evolution/runPhase0Tests.ts passes in the isolated workspace
Execute exactly one Phase 0 runRef ae-skeleton-002 with persona p8-martial-lin, seed 802, endAge 1, catalogVersion 1.0.0, from the isolated workspace

The Phase 0 source fingerprint headSha equals the synthetic baseline commit and worktreeEntries contains exactly one entry for src/data/lines/general.json with status ' M' and the exact modified file SHA-256
The sealed catalog contains AE-SKELETON-002 in birth_wuxia_family.content.text and the sealed observable payload contains a story_event titled 降生武侠世家 whose body contains AE-SKELETON-002

The experiment root and anchor validate, no second run is executed, and no feedback, hypothesis, investigation, candidate, promotion, external participant, origin commit/stash/reset, or isolation framework is started
